hero.title: Your health, our
hero.description: Quality medical care for the whole family. With 3 exclusive maternity operating rooms, in-house imaging, and a team of specialists committed to your well-being.

servicesSection.title: Our
servicesSection.description: Everything under one roof. No referrals or unnecessary transfers.

medicina-general.name: General Medicine
medicina-general.desc: Comprehensive medical consultation for the whole family.
medicina-general.full: Our general practitioners provide complete medical care for patients of all ages. From common illnesses to the monitoring of chronic conditions, we are here to take care of your health at every stage of life.

process.title: Book your appointment
process.desc: Via WhatsApp, phone, or our online form.

process.title: Medical consultation
process.desc: The doctor evaluates you, listens to your symptoms, and performs a physical exam.

process.title: Diagnosis and plan
process.desc: You receive your diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up instructions.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment?
faq.a: Yes, we recommend booking to reduce wait times. We also handle emergencies.

faq.q: How long does a consultation last?
faq.a: Approximately 20–30 minutes depending on the reason for the visit.

faq.q: Do you see children?
faq.a: General Medicine sees patients 12 and older. For younger children, we have Pediatrics.

pediatria-neonatologia.name: Pediatrics & Neonatology
pediatria-neonatologia.desc: Specialized care for babies and children, with a 24/7 neonatal unit.
pediatria-neonatologia.full: We have 3 exclusive maternity operating rooms and a team of highly trained pediatricians and neonatologists to accompany your baby from the very first moments of life. Our NICU provides top-level care for newborns who need special monitoring.
conditions: Care for healthy and at-risk newborns

process.title: Prenatal registration
process.desc: We register you before delivery to prepare everything for your baby's arrival.

process.title: Birth attendance
process.desc: Our neonatologist receives the baby in the delivery room or operating room.

process.title: Follow-up and discharge
process.desc: We check the baby and teach you the care routines before going home.

faq.q: Do you have a NICU?
faq.a: Yes, we have a neonatal care unit for premature or at-risk newborns.

faq.q: Can I choose the pediatrician for my baby?
faq.a: Yes, you can request a preferred doctor when registering your pregnancy with us.

faq.q: What ages does the pediatrician see?
faq.a: From birth through 17 years.

ginecologia-obstetricia.name: Gynecology & Obstetrics
ginecologia-obstetricia.desc: Prenatal care, natural deliveries, and C-sections in exclusive maternity ORs.
ginecologia-obstetricia.full: Our gynecologists accompany women at every stage: from adolescence through menopause. With three exclusive maternity operating rooms and in-house imaging technology, we provide complete care throughout pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum.
conditions: Pap smear and cervical cancer screening

process.title: First consultation
process.desc: Full evaluation, medical history, and initial tests if needed.

process.title: Prenatal monitoring
process.desc: Monthly visits (or according to gestational week) with included ultrasound.

process.title: Delivery or C-section
process.desc: Care in our maternity operating rooms with the full team.

faq.q: Do you handle emergency deliveries?
faq.a: Yes, we have 24-hour obstetric on-call coverage for emergencies.

faq.q: Is the obstetric ultrasound done at the clinic?
faq.a: Yes, we have our own imaging unit — no need to go elsewhere.

faq.q: Can my partner be present at the delivery?
faq.a: Yes, we allow a support person during vaginal delivery and recovery.

cardiologia.name: Cardiology
cardiologia.desc: Diagnosis and treatment of heart and circulatory diseases.
cardiologia.full: Our cardiologist performs comprehensive evaluations of the cardiovascular system, including electrocardiograms, echocardiograms, and stress tests. Timely diagnosis can save lives.

process.title: Initial consultation
process.desc: Medical history, exam, and electrocardiogram in the same visit.

process.title: Additional studies
process.desc: Echocardiogram or stress test as needed, performed at our clinic.

process.title: Treatment plan
process.desc: Medication adjustment, lifestyle changes, and follow-up appointments.

faq.q: Is the echocardiogram done at the clinic?
faq.a: Yes, we perform it with our in-house imaging equipment.

faq.q: When should I go to cardiac emergency?
faq.a: For chest pain, difficulty breathing, or fainting, seek care immediately.

faq.q: How often should I have a heart check-up?
faq.a: An annual check is recommended from age 40, or earlier if risk factors are present.

cirugia-general.name: General Surgery
cirugia-general.desc: Surgical procedures including laparoscopy and minimally invasive techniques.
cirugia-general.full: We have 2 fully equipped general surgery operating rooms with state-of-the-art technology. Our surgical team handles everything from minor procedures to complex surgeries, following international safety standards.

process.title: Pre-operative assessment
process.desc: The surgeon evaluates the case and orders the necessary lab and imaging studies.

process.title: Scheduled surgery
process.desc: Performed in one of our 2 operating rooms with a certified anesthesiologist.

process.title: Recovery and discharge
process.desc: Post-surgical monitoring and a care plan for your recovery at home.

faq.q: Do you perform laparoscopic surgery?
faq.a: Yes, most abdominal surgeries are performed laparoscopically when possible.

faq.q: Do you have your own anesthesiologist?
faq.a: Yes, our certified anesthesiologists are present at every surgery.

faq.q: How long is the recovery after surgery?
faq.a: It depends on the procedure. Laparoscopic surgery allows faster recovery (2–5 days).

nutricion-clinica.name: Clinical Nutrition
nutricion-clinica.desc: Personalized nutrition plans integrated with medical treatment.
nutricion-clinica.full: Our nutritionist designs personalized eating plans based on your health status, goals, and preferences. We work closely with the rest of the medical team for a comprehensive approach.

process.title: Nutritional assessment
process.desc: Bioimpedance, anthropometric measurements, and analysis of your current diet.

process.title: Personalized plan
process.desc: You receive an eating plan tailored to your lifestyle and health condition.

process.title: Monthly follow-up
process.desc: We review your progress and adjust the plan based on your results.

faq.q: Does the nutritionist work with the doctor?
faq.a: Yes, our approach is multidisciplinary for more effective results.

faq.q: How many consultations do I need?
faq.a: We recommend at least 3 follow-up visits in the first 3 months.

faq.q: Can I keep eating foods I enjoy?
faq.a: The plan adapts to your preferences — it's about balancing, not eliminating.

laboratorio-clinico.name: Clinical Laboratory
laboratorio-clinico.desc: In-house lab tests with same-day results.
laboratorio-clinico.full: Our in-house clinical laboratory processes most tests the same day. No need to leave the clinic: the doctor orders the tests and you have them done right here, speeding up your diagnosis and treatment.
conditions: Complete blood count and blood chemistry

process.title: Doctor's order
process.desc: Your doctor specifies the tests needed for your case.

process.title: Sample collection
process.desc: Trained staff collects the blood, urine, or other sample.

process.title: Results
process.desc: Most tests are ready the same day; your doctor reviews and interprets them.

faq.q: Do I need to fast?
faq.a: For glucose, cholesterol, and blood chemistry tests, yes (8–12 hours of fasting).

faq.q: How quickly will I get my results?
faq.a: Basic tests: 2–4 hours. Cultures: 24–72 hours depending on the study.

faq.q: Can I request tests without a doctor's order?
faq.a: Yes, some routine tests can be requested directly. Ask us which ones.

imagenologia.name: Medical Imaging
imagenologia.desc: On-site ultrasound and X-ray for immediate diagnosis.
imagenologia.full: We have our own imaging equipment for ultrasound and X-ray. Having these studies available in-house significantly reduces diagnostic time, and the doctor can review results immediately.

process.title: Doctor's order
process.desc: Your doctor orders the imaging study and it is entered into the system.

process.title: Performing the study
process.desc: Our radiologist or technician performs the ultrasound or X-ray.

process.title: Interpretation and report
process.desc: The doctor receives the result and radiology report the same day.

faq.q: Are obstetric ultrasounds done at the clinic?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the most frequent studies we perform, ideal for prenatal care.

faq.q: Do I need any special preparation?
faq.a: For abdominal ultrasound, a 4-hour fast is recommended. Obstetric ultrasound requires no special preparation.

faq.q: How long until I get my report?
faq.a: The doctor will review the results the same day, usually within 1–2 hours.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked
faqPage.subtitle: If you can't find what you're looking for, call or message us — we respond immediately.
faqPage.ctaDesc: Our team is available 24/7 to answer any questions.

cat1Items.a: For scheduled specialist visits, we recommend booking in advance. For emergencies, we attend immediately 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, with no appointment needed.

cat1Items.q: How can I book an appointment?
cat1Items.a: You can book via WhatsApp, by calling (449) 000-0000, or using the form on our Appointments page. We confirm availability in minutes.

cat1Items.q: How long does a consultation last?
cat1Items.a: A standard consultation lasts 20–30 minutes. First-time visits or those requiring tests may take longer.

cat1Items.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
cat1Items.a: Yes. We ask that you notify us at least 2 hours in advance so we can offer the slot to another patient.

cat2Items.a: Clínica Crystal is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Emergency care is always available.
Yes, we have our own free parking lot for patients and visitors.
Yes, we have a cafeteria and lounge areas on every floor of the building for the comfort of patients and families.
Av. del Parque #348, Col. Jardines del Parque, CP 20276, Aguascalientes, Ags. Between Av. del Lago and Av. Héroe de Nacozari.

cat3Items.a: We offer General Medicine, Pediatrics & Neonatology, Gynecology & Obstetrics, Cardiology, General Surgery, Clinical Nutrition, Clinical Laboratory, and Medical Imaging.

cat3Items.q: Do you have your own laboratory?
cat3Items.a: Yes. Our in-house clinical laboratory delivers same-day results for most tests, with no need for an outside referral.

cat3Items.q: What imaging studies do you perform?
cat3Items.a: We offer ultrasound and X-ray. Studies are performed and interpreted right here at the clinic.

cat3Items.q: Do you handle deliveries and C-sections?
cat3Items.a: Yes. We have 3 exclusive maternity operating rooms and neonatologists on call 24/7 for deliveries, C-sections, and at-risk newborns.

cat4Items.a: We currently serve primarily private-pay patients. Contact us to verify whether your insurer has a current agreement with us.

cat4Items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
cat4Items.a: We accept cash, debit, and credit cards. Consultation and test fees are shared when you book.
